title: Card 2: kai App, aage LB (load balancer). App kuch yaad nahi rakhti, isliye koi bhi App koi bhi click le sakti

boxes.title: LB
lines: har App se poochta: zinda ho?

callouts.red: Ek hi badi machine le lete?
callouts.green: Kitni bhi badi ho, hai to ek hi. Wo giri to poori site band
LB ke "zinda ho?" (/health) ka jawab nahi aaya, LB ne use list se hata diya. Arpan ka agla click App 2 pe gaya

callouts.red: App 3 giri nahi, bas dheemi ho gayi
callouts.green: LB use bhejta jiske paas sabse kam kaam khula hai (least connections). Dheemi App ko kam click milte

callouts.red: Arpan ka login App ke andar hi yaad rakhte?
callouts.green: Arpan usi App se bandh jaata. Wo giri to Arpan logout. Isliye login Redis / DB me rakho

callouts.red: Giri hui App theek ho gayi to? "zinda ho?" pe phir haan bolti, LB use wapas list me le leta.
callouts.green: App kuch yaad nahi rakhti, isliye wapas aate hi kaam pe lag jaati

kyun: App kuch yaad nahi rakhti (login, link sab Redis / DB me), isliye koi bhi App koi bhi click le sakti. LB har App se poochta "zinda ho?", jo chup ho use list se hata deta
peeche: card 1 me Redis lagaya, click pehle Redis se
ab: Usi bheed me Arpan ki site wali ek App machine giri, poori site band
agla: ab kai App hain, sab ek saath code bana rahe. Do ko ek hi code to nahi milega? (card 3)
